name: Undertaking 3
definition: Independent undertaking, such as a demand guarantee or standby letter of credit, that provides financial assurance, to be honoured on the presentation of documents that comply with its terms and conditions.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier assigned by the issuer to the undertaking, for example the guarantee or standby number.

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Name of undertaking such as, demand guarantee, standby letter of credit.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of undertaking, for example, performance, payment.

Applicant.name: Applicant
Applicant.definition: Party named in the undertaking as the “applicant”.

Issuer.name: Issuer
Issuer.definition: Party that issues the undertaking (or counter-undertaking).

Beneficiary.name: Beneficiary
Beneficiary.definition: Party in whose favour the undertaking (or counter-undertaking) is issued.

DateOfIssuance.name: Date Of Issuance
DateOfIssuance.definition: Date on which the undertaking is issued.

PlaceOfIssue.name: Place Of Issue
PlaceOfIssue.definition: Location which is to be regarded as the place from which the undertaking is issued.

AdvisingParty.name: Advising Party
AdvisingParty.definition: Party asked to advise the undertaking to the beneficiary or to another advising party at the request of the issuer.

SecondAdvisingParty.name: Second Advising Party
SecondAdvisingParty.definition: Additional party asked to advise the undertaking.

UndertakingAmount.name: Undertaking Amount
UndertakingAmount.definition: Details related to the amount of the undertaking.

ExpiryDetails.name: Expiry Details
ExpiryDetails.definition: Details related to the expiry of the undertaking.

ConfirmationIndicator.name: Confirmation Indicator
ConfirmationIndicator.definition: Indicates whether or not the advising bank (confirmer) is requested to add its confirmation to the undertaking.

ConfirmationPartyType.name: Confirmation Party Type
ConfirmationPartyType.definition: Indicates the type of party requested to add its confirmation to the undertaking.

AdditionalParty.name: Additional Party
AdditionalParty.definition: Party, in addition to the other parties specified in the undertaking, that is also related to the undertaking.

GovernanceRulesAndLaw.name: Governance Rules And Law
GovernanceRulesAndLaw.definition: Rules and laws governing the undertaking.

UnderlyingTransaction.name: Underlying Transaction
UnderlyingTransaction.definition: Details of the underlying transaction for which the undertaking is issued.

PresentationDetails.name: Presentation Details
PresentationDetails.definition: Presentation details related to the undertaking.

UndertakingTermsAndConditions.name: Undertaking Terms And Conditions
UndertakingTermsAndConditions.definition: Terms and conditions of the undertaking.

MultipleDemandIndicator.name: Multiple Demand Indicator
MultipleDemandIndicator.definition: Indicates that multiple demands are not permitted.

PartialDemandIndicator.name: Partial Demand Indicator
PartialDemandIndicator.definition: Indicates that partial demands/drawings are not permitted.

ConfirmationChargesPayableBy.name: Confirmation Charges Payable By
ConfirmationChargesPayableBy.definition: Indicates whether the applicant/obligor or beneficiary is responsible for payment of the confirmation charges.

TransferChargesPayableBy.name: Transfer Charges Payable By
TransferChargesPayableBy.definition: Indicates whether the applicant/obligor or beneficiary is responsible for payment of the transfer charges.

AutomaticAmountVariation.name: Automatic Amount Variation
AutomaticAmountVariation.definition: Details related to a variation in amount that is automatically applied.

TransferIndicator.name: Transfer Indicator
TransferIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the undertaking is transferable.

EnclosedFile.name: Enclosed File
EnclosedFile.definition: Document or template enclosed in the undertaking directly related to the issued undertaking.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional information related to the undertaking.

RequestedLocalUndertaking.name: Requested Local Undertaking
RequestedLocalUndertaking.definition: Details of the local or ancillary undertaking requested to be issued by a local or other issuing institution.

SecondAdvisingPartyRule.definition: If SecondAdvisingParty is present, then AdvisingParty must be present.

ConfirmationPartyType1Rule.definition: If ConfirmationIndicator is "true', then ConfirmationPartyType must be "CONF".

ConfirmationPartyType2Rule.definition: If ConfirmationPartyType is "CONF", then one occurrence of AdditionalParty/Type/Code must be "CONF".

AdvisingPartyRule.definition: If IssuanceType is UndertakingViaAdvisingParty(ISAD) then AdvisingParty must be present.

PlaceOfPresentation1Rule.definition: If PlaceOfPresentation is "PRES", then one occurrence of AdditionalParty/TypeCode must be "PRES".

Type1Rule.definition: Type must present if IssuanceType is ISSU, ISAD, ISCO.

MultipleDemandIndicatorRule.definition: If MultipleDemandIndicator is "true" or "1" (Yes), then PartialDemandIndicator cannot be "false" or "0" (No).

PlaceOfIssue1Rule.definition: Place of Issue must be specified when the address is different from the address specified for the issuer.
